Instructions: Tableau accesses HetuEngine, but Tableau does not provide the corresponding connector. It is necessary to package the HetuEngine connector according to the guidance on the Tableau official website.


Step 1: Please refer to the "Before you begin" section on the official website to prepare the compilation and packaging environment. The HetuEngine connector source code is stored in the tableau_trino_jdbc_hetu_connector directory.
https://tableau.github.io/connector-plugin-sdk/docs/package-sign#before-you-begin

Step 2: Please refer to the "Package the connector" section on the official website to compile and package the HetuEngine connector, generating a file with the.TACO suffix.
https://tableau.github.io/connector-plugin-sdk/docs/package-sign#package-the-connector
